statement.p: A watchs wholesale price was {\$300.00}. The retailer marked up the price by 25\%. Whats the watchs new price (markup price)?

solution.p: First, we need to find the amount of increase in price. Its given that the watchs price was marked up by 25\% of its original price, {\$300.00}.
The problem can be boiled down to this question: What is 25\% of 300? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem. Assume 25\% of 300 is x, so 25 out of 100 corresponds to x out of 300.
We will write and solve the proportion:
The amount of price increase was {\$75.00}, so the new price is {\$300.00}+{\$75.00}={\$375.00}.
So the watchs markup price is {\$375.00}.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem. This translation from English to math may help you remember the percentage formula.
